name: Jakarta Islamic School (JISc) Joglo
address: Jl. Rudal V No.16, Joglo, Jakarta Barat

notes.id: Uang pangkal termasuk 6 seragam dan SPP 1 bulan. Kenaikan SPP 10–20% per tingkat. Artikel blog menyebut tahun ajaran 2026, tetapi angkanya tampak lama (2020–2023). Konfirmasi ke sekolah.
notes.en: Entry fee includes 6 uniforms and 1 month's tuition. Tuition rises 10–20% per grade. The blog post says academic year 2026, but the figures look old (2020–2023). Confirm with the school.
